jobs.name: Oracle Index Update
jobs.prompt: Run Oracle index update: execute the oracle_index_update.py script from the autognosia repository. This script incrementally updates the Oracle search index by detecting modified wiki files since the last run, running graphify extract in incremental mode (never --force), and merging new chunks into the existing graph. Unlike a full rebuild (which takes ~24h), this incremental update only processes changed files and should complete in minutes. Appends to the existing graph rather than rebuilding from scratch. Log results to oracle/brain/rebuild-log.md.
